title: Interfaced Commands : Weather & Day
description: Finally, the Minecraft text-based commands are now graphical and visual interfaces.
body:
![interfacedcommands logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f228a1fed223638bf2138e07f439f0eaffb40861_0.webp)
## Development :
I started this mod on March 25 of 2026 with the objective to make Minecraft commands more
easier to use.
## Description :
This mod is a part of a big series about making minecraft commands easier to use.
this one is centalized around Weather (not included for this moment) and Time of day.
## Softwares used :
MCreator 2025.3
### Extensions used with :
Blocky to Java Direct Translator
## others informations :
This mod is finished
